svg.title: Phase platform
svg.desc: Access: AI agents, CLI, SDKs and REST API, CI, Terraform and Kubernetes reach into the Phase secret store across develop, build, deploy and run. Store: apps, environments, paths and key-value secrets of three types — config, secret and sealed. Automate: rotation, dynamic secrets and syncs to cloud secret managers, CI and hosting platforms. Control and monitor: authentication, network access policies and audit logs.
